description: Exact conjunction requiring one common Z0 for the bipartite normal block-support and nonbipartite joint-support systems.

quantifiers.Z0: for that seed, every eligible Z0 fails at least one system; both systems are tested on the same Z0
quantifiers.generic_orientation: a bipartite component passes if either generic orientation or the separate lightlike alternative passes
quantifiers.nonbipartite_coloring: a Z0 passes if some symmetry-reduced light-ray coloring has a joint actual-support assignment
quantifiers.seed: a graph is rejected if one required K6 seed is impossible

semantics.allowed_defects: upper bounds; allowed coordinates may be zero
semantics.arithmetic: exact rational/integer decisions; no floating tolerance
semantics.survivor: filter non-rejection only, not a realizability claim
